title: Autorun task is deleted and recreated with hardcoded PT03S delay on every elevated launch, making the tray icon startup race unworkaroundable

judgment.rationale: The task-customization reset is directly supported by current source and needs no additional reporter checklist. Treat task identity validation/idempotent update as the bounded direction; do not merely lengthen the hardcoded delay or promise to solve the independent Explorer/tray readiness race.
evidence: The report supplies the exact elevated/startup configuration, PT3S-to-one-minute task edit, reboot sequence, source analysis, and a diagnostic ZIP for 0.100.2.
The supplied archive's general settings confirm startup and run_elevated are both true; this is not an unconfigured-startup report.
The claimed tray icon race and loss of task history are consequences reported by the author; changing the task lifecycle alone does not establish a tray-registration fix.

proposed_fixes.title: Make elevated autorun-task maintenance idempotent
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Confirmed source mechanism for delay reset: each elevated startup deletes the existing task, and the replacement uses the hardcoded three-second delay. The separate tray registration failure remains unproven.
plan: Define the required task identity, executable action, principal, and run-level invariants.
Retain/enable an equivalent task rather than delete/recreate it; update required identity/action changes without silently resetting compatible trigger customization.
Add regression coverage for repeated elevated launches, executable relocation, elevation-mode changes, startup disable, and managed startup policy; assess tray readiness separately.
verification: An edited one-minute delay survives repeated equivalent elevated launches and reboot.
Stale action paths/principals are corrected, and startup-off/GPO behavior does not regress.

actions.label: Verify elevated startup preserves a customized task delay

reproduce.title: Verify elevated startup preserves a customized task delay
reproduce.version_requirement: Reported 0.100.2 versus current stable and current main on an isolated Windows account.
prerequisites: Use an isolated test account or controlled test machine; preserve existing user data.
steps: 1. Enable Run at startup and Always run as administrator; preserve/export the original task.
2. Change only the autorun task logon delay to one minute; launch PowerToys elevated twice and compare task XML after each launch.
3. Repeat after a controlled reboot, then exercise executable-path changes and enabling/disabling elevated startup.
4. Evaluate tray registration separately when Explorer is deliberately late; do not treat a preserved delay as proof that the tray race is fixed.
reproduce.expected_result: An equivalent existing task retains its supported trigger configuration; required path/principal corrections and startup policy still take effect.
